hero.headline: The AI beat, {curated} before {coffee}.
hero.lede: Every morning at 06:00, Curio reads the lab blogs, the pricing pages, the release notes and the bench charts — and writes you a five-minute brief on the AI model news that actually matters. Then it quizzes you on it, because we don't trust ourselves to remember it either.

stories.title: Anthropic turns on long-horizon tool use by default
stories.dek: What changed in the API — and the setting most teams will want to flip on.

stories.title: A new open mixture-of-experts model posts strong early numbers
stories.dek: Who shipped it, how big it is, and where it lands against the incumbents.

stories.title: Another round of API price cuts reshuffles the cost table
stories.dek: The new per-million rates, lined up against last month's.

method.headline: Built like a newsroom, {tail}
method.body: We don't aggregate. We summarize first-party announcements — Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepMind, Meta AI, Mistral, Hugging Face — and stitch them into a single edition tuned to the topics you've picked. Three steps, every morning, for as long as you want it.

steps.title: You pick the beats
steps.body: Choose from 18 model-specific topics — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, agentic frameworks, benchmarks. Pick at least three. Change them whenever.

steps.title: We file before dawn
steps.body: Curio scans first-party feeds and lab blogs, asks Claude Sonnet to summarize like a senior editor, then files an issue tuned to your beats.

steps.title: You read by 06:00
steps.body: Five-minute brief in your inbox. Five-question quiz on the web. We track what you remember — and what to revisit.

beat.headline: The labs we {cover}
beat.body: Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepMind, xAI, Meta AI, DeepSeek, Alibaba, Mistral — plus the agentic swarm (Cursor, Devin, Claude Code, browser-use). Pick your topics, drop the rest.

quote.text: “Everything that mattered in AI yesterday — {br} in {minutes}, not fifty tabs.”

subscribe.headline: Read tomorrow's {edition}.
subscribe.body: Free while we test — full archive, all topics, daily editions through July 2026, no credit card. Paid plans with extra features arrive August–September.

footer.tagline: — A daily for AI model news · Vol. {vol}
